specialty_focus: The Jean Coutu Group operates a prominent Canadian pharmacy chain specializing in prescription drugs, health care, and an extensive array of beauty and consumer products. Jean Coutu The Jean Coutu Group operates as a major Canadian pharmacy network owned by Metro Inc. It distributes thousands of branded and generic products through centralized warehousing, relies on a cooperative franchising model with independent pharmacist principals, and features major beauty, health, and private-label brands
